account_level_management_enabled.description: Whether the card program is participating in Account Level Management. Currently applicable to Visa card programs only.

cardholder_currency.description: 3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code for the currency of the cardholder.

created.description: Timestamp of when the card program was created.

name.description: The name of the card program.

pan_range_end.description: The first digits of the card number that this card program ends with.

pan_range_start.description: The first digits of the card number that this card program starts with.

settlement_currencies.description: List of 3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 codes for the currencies that the card program supports for settlement.
